title: Holdings Limit per Member on Construction Loans
content:
A member of the association may hold at most 2 Construction Loans at once, and no more than one of them may be a home construction loan.

## Policy statement

1. A member may hold at most 2 construction loans in applied, active, extended or converting status at once, and at most one of them may be a home construction product (Owner-Builder, Single-Close, Two-Close or Post-Frame), because a member builds one residence at a time; the others may only be farm building or livestock facility loans.
2. Commitments of all of them count toward the farm real estate and Country Home limits of the permanent products they convert into.

## Which loans count

- **Counted:** each of the member's Construction Loans whose status is applied, active, extended or converting.
- **Home construction product:** the Owner-Builder, Single-Close, Two-Close and Post-Frame Home Construction Loans — the products whose permanent financing is a Country Home loan.
- **Other construction loans:** the Farm Building Construction Loan and the Livestock Facility Construction Loan.

## Evidence

The one-home-build limit applies when a construction loan application is registered. Whether the member already holds a home construction loan is read, before the application is registered, from the association's own records of that member's Construction Loans — each loan's status and the line it converts into — and not from the member's account of what they hold. Every other construction loan on record for the same member counts, whatever its own loan number.

## Cases (hypothetical holdings)

| Already held by the member, in a counted status | Applied for | Result under clauses 1 and 2 |
|---|---|---|
| None | Single-Close Home Construction Loan | Within the limit: 1 loan, 1 home construction product |
| Farm Building Construction Loan | Two-Close Home Construction Loan | Within the limit: 2 loans, 1 home construction product |
| Post-Frame Home Construction Loan | Livestock Facility Construction Loan | Within the limit: 2 loans, 1 home construction product |
| Owner-Builder Home Construction Loan | Single-Close Home Construction Loan | Outside the limit: a second home construction product |
| Farm Building Construction Loan and Livestock Facility Construction Loan | Farm Building Construction Loan | Outside the limit: a third construction loan |

A loan of the member's whose status is converted, paid off or declined is not in a counted status and is not counted toward either figure in clause 1.
